Name: Keybind Radar
Author: Wooa404
Description:
[b]Find your shortcuts. Spot conflicts. Stay organized.[/b]
Tired of opening multiple mod configuration menus just to find a single shortcut?
Keybind Radar brings your mod keybinds together in one convenient interface, helping you find shortcuts, identify potential conflicts, and keep your controls organized.
Whether you have a handful of mods or hundreds installed, Keybind Radar makes managing your shortcuts easier.
[line]
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[b]🔍 Keybind Scanner[/b]
Automatically scans supported mod configuration files to discover keybind settings.

[b]⚠️ Conflict Detection[/b]
Highlights potentially conflicting keybinds so you can easily identify shortcuts that may overlap.

[b]⌨️ Keyboard & Controller Support[/b]
Switch between keyboard and controller keybinds to keep your shortcut lists organized.
Your selected input type is saved and restored the next time you open the menu.

[b]🔎 Search & Filters[/b]
Quickly find keybinds using the search bar.

Filter your list by:
[list]
[*]All — View all detected keybinds.[/*]
[*]Conflicts — Show potentially conflicting shortcuts.[/*]
[*]Unassigned — Find keybinds that have not been assigned.[/*]
[/list][b]⚙️ GMCM Integration[/b]
Open a mod's Generic Mod Config Menu settings directly from Keybind Radar when supported.
If a mod doesn't provide a compatible settings menu, Keybind Radar will let you know.
[line]
[heading]📦 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Keybind Radar.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]⚠️ Important Notes[/heading]
Keybind Radar currently uses configuration-file scanning to discover keybinds.
Some mods may store their keybinds in custom formats, use hardcoded shortcuts, or register keybinds in ways that cannot be detected through configuration files.
As a result, not every keybind is guaranteed to appear.
Conflict detection identifies potential overlaps between detected keybinds. Whether two shortcuts actually interfere with each other may depend on how the individual mods handle input.
Keybind Radar does not automatically modify your keybind settings.
[line]
[heading]💬 Feedback & Bug Reports[/heading]
Found a missing keybind, an incorrect conflict, or a compatibility issue?
Please report any issues in the post section and include the mod name, the keybind involved.
Your feedback helps improve Keybind Radar!

You can upload your SMAPI log here:
https://smapi.io/log

On Windows:
1. Press Win + R.
2. Enter:
   %appdata%\StardewValley\ErrorLogs
3. Look for SMAPI-crash.txt. If there isn't one, use SMAPI-latest.txt.
4. Drag the file onto the SMAPI Log Parser page and click "Save & parse log".
5. Copy the generated link.

After uploading your log, please send me the generated link through the Posts section or a private message.

I plan to actively maintain Keybind Radar and fix any bugs or compatibility issues that are reported, so please don't hesitate to send me your logs if you encounter a problem.

The more reports and logs I receive, the easier it will be to identify issues that may only occur with certain mods or setups.

Thank you for helping me make Keybind Radar better! 📡
